initialExam.title: State TET (Various States) 2026
initialExam.description: State-level Teacher Eligibility Test conducted by individual states. Required for state government school teaching positions.
initialExam.syllabus: Child Development & Pedagogy, Language-I, Language-II, Mathematics, Environmental Studies/Science/Social Studies. Pattern similar to CTET.
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I (Class 1-5): 150Q, 150 marks, 2.5 hours. Paper-II (Class 6-8): 150Q, 150 marks, 2.5 hours.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Qualify State TET → Apply for state teaching posts
initialExam.jobRole: Eligibility for teaching posts in respective state government schools
initialExam.careerGrowth: Teacher → Head Teacher → BEO → DEO through state processes.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit respective state education board website 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Vacation, State-specific benefits
